initial: Use case: stylized-concept. Art approval concept for Seedlands CLASSIC playbook, specifically the nostalgic visual language of Minecraft Java Beta 1.7.3 circa 2011. Original authored artwork, not extracted textures. Strict early voxel game aesthetics: visibly coarse 16x16 pixel textures with intentional pixel clusters, simple low polygon cuboids, square corners, no bevels, no subdivided voxel sculptures, no modern resource-pack detail, no realistic materials, no ambient-occlusion glamour, no cinematic grading, no depth of field, no bloom, no modern smooth shadows. Modest flat directional shading, old-fashioned saturated grass green and sky blue, earthy brown dirt, neutral gray stone. Keep proportions plain and utilitarian rather than cute miniature toys. Crisp nearest-neighbor pixels. Create board 1, wide landscape, title "CLASSIC / WORLD + LIGHT". Two equal large panels of gameplay-like first-person views, very restrained dark gray title strip and thin divider. LEFT DAY: rolling simple grass-and-dirt block hills, cubic oak tree canopy, small plain plank house, pink cuboid pig and brown-white cow, sparse crossed flat sprite tallgrass and yellow/red flowers with green stems. Distinct bare grass blocks between plants. Blue sky and rectangular flat clouds. A plain blocky sleeve/hand holds an old-school flat pixel stone pickaxe at lower right. Bottom gray nine-slot hotbar with distinct pixel items and red hearts above, absolutely no hunger bar because this is Beta-era presentation. Keep HUD minimal. RIGHT NIGHT: simple stone-and-plank room showing a wall torch and luminous cream-gold glowstone block creating visibly stepped warm pools of block light on floor and walls, a stone occluding partition with darker far side, no fog glow or cinematic beams, no diamond ore glowing. Include chest and furnace, their top and front faces visibly distinct. Short captions only "DAY / 16px" and "NIGHT / BLOCK LIGHT". Must feel like modest old 2011 game screenshots rather than polished 3D illustration. This is a design mockup, not proof of real rendering.

Use case: stylized-concept. Art approval concept for Seedlands CLASSIC playbook, specifically the nostalgic visual language of Minecraft Java Beta 1.7.3 circa 2011. Original authored artwork, not extracted textures. Strict early voxel game aesthetics: visibly coarse 16x16 pixel textures with intentional pixel clusters, simple low polygon cuboids, square corners, no bevels, no subdivided voxel sculptures, no modern resource-pack detail, no realistic materials, no ambient-occlusion glamour, no cinematic grading, no depth of field, no bloom, no modern smooth shadows. Modest flat directional shading, old-fashioned saturated grass green and sky blue, earthy brown dirt, neutral gray stone. Keep proportions plain and utilitarian rather than cute miniature toys. Crisp nearest-neighbor pixels. Create board 2, wide landscape, title "CLASSIC / TEXTURES + ITEMS". A precise clean asset direction sheet on neutral mid-gray background, 3 horizontal sections. Top section "TERRAIN" has 12 equal enlarged square nearest-neighbor pixel texture tiles with clearly COARSE 16x16-style cells: grass top, grass side with dirt, dirt, stone, cobblestone with irregular stone cluster structure, vertical oak bark, square log-end rings, horizontal wood planks, red brick courses, sand, cream-white wool, iron ore with a few grouped tan deposits. Middle section "FUNCTION + SHAPE" shows 8 plain cubic/non-cubic realtime game objects: bookshelf with readable book spines, furnace with dark mouth, wooden door with window and handle, open-rung ladder, torch, half-height slab, two-step wooden stairs, simple wooden fence. Bottom section "ITEMS + COLOR" displays red flower with stem, yellow flower, red white-speckled mushroom, branching dead bush, stone pickaxe, iron sword, round chocolate-chip cookie, book with visible white pages, red terracotta brick, porkchop, followed by a compact row of exactly sixteen clearly distinct wool color swatches. Item icons are flat deliberately authored coarse pixel sprites with transparent silhouettes over the sheet, approximately 16x16 style, no detailed isometric rendered food, no noisy square stand-ins. Every panel uses consistent pixel density. Add a tiny native-scale and an 8x enlarged sample of one flower to indicate pixel scale. No ornate frames, no detailed shadows. No need to label each tiny item, only section headings.

Use case: stylized-concept. Art approval concept for Seedlands CLASSIC playbook, specifically the nostalgic visual language of Minecraft Java Beta 1.7.3 circa 2011. Original authored artwork, not extracted textures. Strict early voxel game aesthetics: visibly coarse 16x16 pixel textures with intentional pixel clusters, simple low polygon cuboids, square corners, no bevels, no subdivided voxel sculptures, no modern resource-pack detail, no realistic materials, no ambient-occlusion glamour, no cinematic grading, no depth of field, no bloom, no modern smooth shadows. Modest flat directional shading, old-fashioned saturated grass green and sky blue, earthy brown dirt, neutral gray stone. Keep proportions plain and utilitarian rather than cute miniature toys. Crisp nearest-neighbor pixels. Create board 3, wide landscape, title "CLASSIC / CREATURES". Clean comparative model design sheet on flat light gray background, 3 rows of 4 evenly spaced creatures with tiny uppercase labels and subtle ground baselines. Row1 PIG, COW, SHEEP, CHICKEN. Row2 SQUID, WOLF, ZOMBIE, SKELETON. Row3 SPIDER, CREEPER, SLIME, PIG ZOMBIE. These are original game asset studies in plain early-Minecraft-era construction. Pig has rectangular pink body, separate square head, short square snout, four separated stubby cuboid legs; no sculpted cheeks or hooves. Cow cuboid body, small horns, brown-white coarse pixel patches. Sheep broad simple cuboid wool shell and face, no individually modeled wool lumps. Chicken simple cuboid body/head and very thin legs. Squid straight simple box head and eight rectangular arms, plain coarse dark blue texture. Wolf simple cuboid torso and muzzle, gray-white flat texture. Zombie human rectangular limbs, green face and plain faded shirt/trousers. Skeleton thin rectangular bones and a bow, legible gaps. Spider low rectangular body and eight angular rectangular legs. Creeper tall plain green pixel-textured body and four feet. Slime one translucent green cube with square face, not round jelly. Pig zombie a plain pig-faced humanoid with patchy undead color and simple gold sword. No gear ornamentation, no rounded cute faces, no dense bevels, no realistic fur, no tiny geometric texture bumps. Add a narrow bottom strip "PIG / FRONT - SIDE - WALK" with simple three views clearly showing pig silhouette and opposite leg swing. Only these 12 classic species; no deer, custom stalker, backpack adventurer or modern mobs. All at readable comparable scale, aquatic/ground differences apparent.
